question: Will there be a GitHub incident affecting Pull Requests by Oct 7, 2026 at 2:00 PM PDT?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if GitHub's official status page (githubstatus.com) records at least one incident that explicitly affects the Pull Requests component, with an incident start time strictly after 2026-10-06T19:55:20.096Z and at or before 2026-10-07T21:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if no such incident affecting the Pull Requests component is recorded on GitHub's official status page with a start time strictly after 2026-10-06T19:55:20.096Z and at or before 2026-10-07T21:00:00.000Z.

Clarifications:
- A qualifying incident is any event posted to githubstatus.com that lists "Pull Requests" as an affected component, regardless of severity level (degraded performance, partial outage, or major outage), as long as the incident's recorded start time falls within the window defined above.
